narrative: Weekend reports of a bulk carrier struck in the Strait of Hormuz set up a geopolitical risk premium for the Tokyo open, amid Iranian assertions of maritime authority and US territorial claims. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1573, but faces downside risk if geopolitical escalation supports the USD, while GBP/USD (Friday close: 1.3533) remains vulnerable despite a +11bp OIS carry advantage. Potential crude supply disruptions would likely support CAD/JPY at Sunday's open, following a G10-leading weekly performance (CAD 1W avg: +1.052%, JPY 1W avg: -0.974%, spread: 2.026%). Markets shift focus to Monday’s SEK Riksbank meeting and Tuesday’s RBNZ decision for further G10 direction.
